answer: An AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks through economic staking. Each agent must stake scarce computational credits or tokens, creating a prohibitive financial barrier. This prevents an attacker from generating a vast spiral of fake identities, as acquiring sufficient stake for each would lead to an unsustainable capital expenditure. The aggregate staked value forms a resilient reef, safeguarding network integrity. Malicious activity triggers stake slashing, ensuring attackers face immediate asset forfeiture, their efforts extinguished like a comet entering an atmosphere.
